title: Generic section comparison for the concrete trait normalization
statement: In the integral Noetherian normal base and generic Galois-cover setup of lem-sbc-trait-divisor-chart-section-generic-factor, retain the same c, section sigma, generic fibre q,j, compatible generic section seta, cover Z, finite etale model PA on C_U, and pullback comparison psi. At the boundary point s write a:Spec O_(S,s)->S, L=pullback c a, n for the projection of the pullback of the concrete normalization of PA->C to L, and tau for the induced trait section. For any domain A, fraction field K with its specified algebra structure, and injective delta:O_(S,s)->A, put t=Spec((algebraMap A K).comp delta). There exist b:Spec K->Spec k(S) and an isomorphism beta:pullback n (t;tau) ~= pullback Z.pi (b;seta) preserving the projections to Spec K [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-fibre-product].

proof.text:
Compose delta with the fraction-field inclusion and extend this injection
uniquely from O_(S,s) to its fraction field k(S). Applying Spec gives b and the
identity t followed by a = b followed by the generic-point inclusion. The section
compatibility then identifies t followed by tau and the projection to C with
b followed by seta, jU and the open inclusion. The existing normalization-over-an-open
isomorphism identifies PA with the normalization over C pulled back to C_U; PA is
finite and therefore equals its relative normalization over C_U. Paste this square
with hpsi and the pullback along b followed by seta. Paste the defining square of
n with the pullback along t followed by tau. Their bottom morphisms agree by the
section identity, so uniqueness of pullbacks gives beta with the asserted projection
equality. This proof uses no ramification, smooth ascent of normality, or split fibre.
